parsedVerdict.reasoning: WorkshopController is in the presentation layer. Most of its methods only delegate to MaintenanceService or MileageService and map the result to JSON, which fits that layer. But openOrder applies its own limit before calling the service: estimatedHours must be greater than 0 and at most 40, or it throws a FleetError with a 400 status. The 40-hour cap is a business policy about valid work-order estimates, not a check on the input's shape or format, so it belongs in the domain layer (MaintenanceService.open or a work-order domain model). Because the rule lives only in the controller, other ways into MaintenanceService can bypass it. logHours, closeOrder and reading contain only delegation and response shaping.
